purpose: one-time independent same-model synthetic test of the frozen 29-source eikonal carrier
data: eight new 5 Hz 3-D FD events, dt=0.002 s, duration=2 s, 25 receivers, six zero-Dirichlet faces, same fixed Overthrust velocity; all older observation source coordinates checked for duplicates before FD generation

methods.eikonal_hybrid: fixed FMM first-arrival estimate followed by 27 spatial offsets x 46 origin times (deduplicated at bounds), 12 diverse waveform starts and 250 Adam steps, using the eikonal checkpoint
methods.straight_global: independent 11x11x8x6 global waveform search, 5 starts and 250 Adam steps using the straight checkpoint
methods.fmm: fixed 80 m reciprocal receiver fields, 11x11x8 coarse grid and four 7x7x7 refinements, with the existing first-arrival picker

reporting: per-event eloc, et, source estimate, raw full-record relative L2 for both neural operators, FD/FMM setup and per-event inversion timings, explicit failure status and every predeclared gate
limitations: one model seed, one known synthetic velocity model, no field data or noise stress test; FMM supplies the eikonal hybrid's search initialization, so report FMM setup in its cost. Never tune or reuse these eight events as untouched tests after opening results.
